title: Grilled Argentinian-Style Skirt Steak with Chimichurri
description: A classic Argentinian dish featuring a flavorful skirt steak grilled to perfection and served with a tangy and herby chimichurri sauce.

ingredients.name: Skirt Steak (1.5 lbs)
ingredients.notes: preferably flank steak or flap steak

instructions: Season the skirt steak with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Grill the skirt steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it against the grain.
Meanwhile, mix together the olive oil, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add the chimichurri sauce to the bowl and stir to combine.
Slice the grilled skirt steak and serve with the chimichurri sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
